provenance.split_policy: Deterministic authored dev/heldout labels. Same author and visible labels: heldout is NOT an independently sealed test set.

cases.question: What hand hygiene is recommended before handling contact lenses?

evidence.quote: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and water before handling lenses.

cases.question: Can I swim or shower in contact lenses?

evidence.quote: Remove before swimming or showering to prevent germ exposure.

cases.question: Can I sleep in contacts?

evidence.quote: Avoid sleeping in lenses unless directed by your eye care provider.

cases.question: Contact lens case care

evidence.quote: Store case upside down with caps off after each use.

cases.question: How do I clean my contact lenses?

evidence.quote: Rub and rinse lenses with disinfecting solution.

cases.question: Does saline solution disinfect contact lenses?

evidence.quote: Saline solution does not disinfect contact lenses.

cases.question: What do public sources say about instructions for hydrogen peroxide lens solution?

evidence.quote: Follow all instructions in the labeling when you use hydrogen peroxide solution.

cases.question: What do source labels say about the expiration or discard date of contact lens solutions?

evidence.quote: Do not use contact lens solutions that have gone beyond the expiration or discard date.

cases.question: What are daily disposable lenses?

evidence.quote: You wear single-use contact lenses for one day, then throw them away at night.

cases.question: What are contact lenses?

evidence.quote: Contact lenses are medical devices.

cases.question: What is a dilated eye exam?

evidence.quote: A visual field test to check your peripheral (side) vision.

cases.question: What can people do to keep their eyes healthy and protect vision?

evidence.quote: There’s a lot you can do to keep your eyes healthy and protect your vision.

cases.question: ¿Qué higiene de manos se recomienda antes de manipular los lentes?

evidence.quote: Lávese bien las manos con agua y jabón antes de manipular los lentes.

cases.question: Agua y lentes de contacto

evidence.quote: Sáqueselos antes de nadar o ducharse para prevenir la exposición a microbios.

cases.question: Dormir con lentes de contacto

evidence.quote: Evite dormir con los lentes a menos que su proveedor de cuidados de los ojos lo indique.

cases.question: Cuidado del estuche

evidence.quote: Guarde el estuche boca abajo y sin tapa después de cada uso.

cases.question: Limpieza y almacenamiento

evidence.quote: Frote y enjuague los lentes con solución desinfectante.

cases.question: Lentes desechables

evidence.quote: Los lentes de contacto de un solo uso se utilizan por un día y luego se desechan por la noche.

cases.question: ¿Se debe mezclar solución nueva con la antigua en el estuche?

evidence.quote: Evite mezclar la solución nueva con la antigua en el estuche.

cases.question: ¿Se puede usar agua para limpiar o guardar los lentes de contacto?

evidence.quote: Nunca use agua para limpiar o guardar los lentes de contacto
